data.name: Ghaslan
data.long_meaning: Ghaslan is a name derived from the Arabic word ghasil which means 'mountain slayer'. In Islamic history, Ghaslan bin Al-Mundhir Al-Ansari was a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who played a significant role in the Battle of Hunayn. The name carries the symbolism of strength, courage, and victory over challenges, making it a popular choice among Muslim parents.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing strength and courage in the face of adversity.

in_arabic.name: غسلان
in_arabic.meaning: غسلان تعني المغتسلين أو المتطهرين بالماء
in_arabic.long_meaning: غسلان هو اسم مشتق من الفعل 'غسل' الذي يعني التطهير بالماء. في اللغة العربية، يرتبط الغسل بالتطهير من النجاسة أو الإثم، مما يجعل الاسم يحمل معاني النقاء والطهارة. استخدم هذا الاسم في بعض الأحيان في الشعر العربي لوصف حالة من النقاء الروحي.

in_urdu.name: غسلان
in_urdu.meaning: غسلان کا مطلب ہے جو لوگ پانی سے نہاتے ہیں
in_urdu.long_meaning: غسلان ایک عربی نام ہے جو 'غسل' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے نہانا یا پانی سے تطہیر کرنا۔ یہ نام پاکیزگی اور صفائی کی علامت ہے، اور اسلامی ثقافت میں روحانی صفائی کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیا میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان، یہ نام پاکیزگی کے مثالی معانی کے ساتھ اہم ہے۔

in_hindi.name: घस्लान
in_hindi.meaning: घस्लान का अर्थ है जो लोग पानी से नहाते हैं
in_hindi.long_meaning: घस्लान एक अरबी नाम है जो 'घुसल' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है नहाना या पानी से शुद्धि करना। यह नाम पवित्रता और स्वच्छता का प्रतीक है, और इस्लामी संस्कृति में आध्यात्मिक पवित्रता के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम पवित्रता के आदर्श अर्थों के साथ महत्वपूर्ण है।

in_pashto.name: غسلان
in_pashto.meaning: غسلان دئ چې کوم کسان د اوبو څخه غسل کوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: غسلان د عربي نوم څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې معنی يې غسل یا د اوبو په واسطه پاکي کول دي. دا نوم د پاکۍ او صفايي د نښه ده، او د اسلامي کلتور په روحاني پاکۍ کې کارول کیږي. د افغان او پښتن په دود، دا نوم د پاکۍ په مثالي معنی مهم دی.

in_english.name: Ghaslan
in_english.meaning: Ghaslan means those who wash or purify themselves with water
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ghaslan is derived from the Arabic root 'غسل' (ghasl), which means to wash or to purify with water. This root is mentioned in the Quran, emphasizing the act of purification. Historically, the name has been used to signify spiritual cleansing and purity. In Islamic tradition, Ghaslan symbolizes a person who seeks spiritual and physical cleanliness. The name is associated with positive traits like purity, renewal, and devotion.

historical_references.reference: Ghaslan Ibn Al-Mundhir Al-Ansari, also known as Al-Muhajir Al-Kabir, was a famous companion of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and one of the ten promised Paradise. He participated in several major battles, including the Battle of Khaybar and the Battle of Hunayn. He embraced Islam early in the Prophet's mission and was known for his bravery and generosity. His name is also mentioned in several Hadiths.
historical_references.time_period: 6th century CE, during the early years of Islam

historical_references.reference: Ghaslan bin Ajban was a Berber king who ruled over the Maghreb region, primarily modern-day Algeria and Tunisia, in the late 7th and early 8th centuries CE. He was a powerful and influential leader during the Muslim conquest of North Africa and is credited with expanding the Umayyad Caliphate's territories in the region. He is also known for his military prowess and his contribution to the development of the Islamic civilization in North Africa.
historical_references.time_period: Late 7th to early 8th century CE, during the early Muslim expansion into North Africa
